shots.framing: Establishing shot, wide angle, dolly from 1.0 to 1.28, showing an ambiguous ancient Indian landscape to convey mystery of unknown origins.
shots.pose: Wide landscape with layered depth: sky, distant hills, mid-ground trees, foreground grass/rocks. No characters.

shots.framing: Establishing shot, 4 layers (sky, mid-ground house, foreground road with leaf plates, fx light for morning atmosphere). Camera dolly 1.0->1.28.
shots.pose: Wide view of Devidas's house front with road in foreground; leaf plates scattered on road; food preparation visible in house doorway.

shots.framing: Medium shot, slow push 1.0->1.2, no effects. Focus on figure against road background.
shots.pose: Gajanan Maharaj seated on road, wearing old cloth bandi, body relaxed, hands resting on knees.

shots.framing: Extreme close-up, slow push with breathing motion. Transparent face layer for subtle animation.
shots.pose: Close-up of Gajanan's face, eyes fixed on tip of nose (nasagra drishti), calm expression, subtle glow of tapobal on skin.

shots.framing: Medium-wide shot, slow push 1.0->1.2, showing entire figure on road.
shots.pose: Full body view of Gajanan in digambar state (only bandi), no ornaments, posture serene, no distinction of mine/yours.

shots.framing: Full-frame insert of hand and leaf plate, high detail on grain. Transparent hand layer for animation.
shots.pose: Close-up of Gajanan's hand picking up a single rice grain from a leaf plate and bringing it to mouth.

shots.framing: Same composition as S2-2, slow push 1.0->1.2, held for narration duration.
shots.pose: Gajanan remains seated on road, leaf plates before him, morning light continues; narrator voiceover explains Vedic quote and people's lack of understanding.

shots.framing: Wide establishing shot of a rural road at daytime, sky above, road stretching into distance, two figures in mid-ground, foreground elements like trees or fence
shots.pose: Bankatlal and Damodarpant walking side by side on a road, Bankatlal slightly ahead, both looking forward

shots.framing: Medium two-shot, camera slowly pushes in, both figures centered, background road and scenery
shots.pose: Bankatlal and Damodarpant standing still on road, both turned towards left (off-screen), expressions of surprise and curiosity

shots.framing: Two-shot composition, left Bankatlal, right Damodarpant, gentle drift between them
shots.pose: Bankatlal facing Damodarpant, gesturing with hand towards off-screen, Damodarpant listening attentively, slight nod

shots.framing: Medium two-shot, slow push in, warm lighting suggesting realization
shots.pose: Bankatlal and Damodarpant standing side by side, looking thoughtful, gazes directed downward or at each other, contemplative

shots.framing: Wide establishing shot of forest clearing with temple steps; dolly in from 1.0 to 1.28, layers: sky, mid-ground figures, foreground foliage
shots.pose: Bankatlal walking forward toward seated Gajanan; Damodarpant following behind; Gajanan seated cross-legged, head slightly bowed
